title: Kekkei no Me
body:
Syntax: perform kekkei no me

Description: Transforms the current room for 90 seconds. Matching-element jutsu from the caster gain 50% damage; others in the room lose Chakra and Stamina over time. Requires an active Sharingan and this Mangekyo eye technique assigned; authenticated immortals can test every Mangekyo technique without those gates. It is not a normal level unlock. Costs 50 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 120 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
